title: Traffic Violation Notice (e-Challan)

glance.headline: Traffic violation fine of Rs. 1,000.00 for riding without a helmet

summary: A traffic violation notice has been issued to Suresh Raman by the City Traffic Police, Anand Nagar, for riding a two-wheeler without a helmet.
The fine amount is Rs. 1,000.00, which must be paid or contested on or before 05 Dec 2026.
If the fine is not cleared or contested in time, the matter may be referred to the Virtual Court with additional charges.
